candidates.change_summary: Replace selfdestruct with a no-op to prevent contract destruction, keeping the function callable but changing its external effect on contract existence.
Remove the require statement so any caller can trigger selfdestruct, changing who can successfully call the function.
Change the require check to always fail, making the function revert for everyone, changing success/failure behavior.
Change the beneficiary of selfdestruct from msg.sender to smartfix_owner, altering where remaining Ether is sent.
